events.content:
Done. Created a small Next.js app in `/workspace`:

- `npm run dev` to start locally
- `npm run build` to build (already verified)

What it does:
- Home page lists **Currently reading** and **Finished** books
- Form to add a new book (title, author, notes)
- **Finish** button moves a book to finished
- Click a book title to open its own page at `/book/<id>` — shareable link
- Book page shows title, author, notes, and lets you edit or delete
- Books are saved to `data/books.json` so they persist after restart

Key files:
- `app/page.tsx` — home & add form
- `app/book/[id]/page.tsx` — detail/shareable page
- `app/actions.ts` — server actions for add/finish/update/delete
- `lib/books.ts` — JSON file storage
- `data/books.json` — persisted book data

part.text:
Done. Created a small Next.js app in `/workspace`:

- `npm run dev` to start locally
- `npm run build` to build (already verified)

What it does:
- Home page lists **Currently reading** and **Finished** books
- Form to add a new book (title, author, notes)
- **Finish** button moves a book to finished
- Click a book title to open its own page at `/book/<id>` — shareable link
- Book page shows title, author, notes, and lets you edit or delete
- Books are saved to `data/books.json` so they persist after restart

Key files:
- `app/page.tsx` — home & add form
- `app/book/[id]/page.tsx` — detail/shareable page
- `app/actions.ts` — server actions for add/finish/update/delete
- `lib/books.ts` — JSON file storage
- `data/books.json` — persisted book data
